title: server.stt.status
description: Since 1.5: the server-side speech-to-text provider changed between working and degraded (server STT mode). Sent once per change, and after hello.ack while degraded; only to a client that negotiated 1.5 or higher.

state.description: ok: speech is being transcribed (the client clears any STT warning); reconnecting: the provider lost its service and retries, audio meanwhile is not transcribed; unavailable: the provider cannot work at all this session (installation, credentials), no audio is transcribed.

detail.description: A Spanish sentence for the student saying what happens; present when state is not ok.

server_time_ms.description: Backend clock, Unix epoch ms, when the message was sent.
